description: THE INVALID-CONFIRMATION REJECTION - the WHEN OTHER arm of the ordered EVALUATE CONFIRMI at app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:185-190, and with it the one sequencing quirk this program is most often translated wrongly: the two MOVEs at :193-194, which sit OUTSIDE that EVALUATE and therefore run AFTER the screen has already been sent. Derived from app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:154-206 together with :289-301 and :319-338, and reached through :123-127. CONFIRMI OF COBIL0AI arrives as 'X' - one character, and none of the six values the four preceding WHEN clauses name - so control falls through to WHEN OTHER, :186 raises the error flag, :187-188 loads the message, :189 puts the cursor on CONFIRML and :190 sends exactly one screen. THE PRECONDITIONS, AND WHY THIS IS THE RE-ENTRY ARM. :107 finds EIBCALEN non-zero, so the cold-start arm at :108-109 is not taken and :111 copies the travelled area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. :112 IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE because CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1, so control takes the ELSE at :123: :124 performs RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :125-142 matches WHEN DFHENTER at :126, which performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :127. That is the REENTER side of gate G38. RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN at :306-314 captures RESP(WS-RESP-CD) and RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) and then NEVER TESTS EITHER - there is no EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD after it anywhere in the program - and that is preserved rather than tidied into a guard. THE CHARACTER, AND WHY THIS ONE. CONFIRMI is 'X', US-ASCII 0x58, and it is named here rather than left to be inferred. It fails all six preceding clauses individually: it is not 'Y' [:174], not 'y' [:175], not 'N' [:178], not 'n' [:179], not SPACES [:182] and not LOW-VALUES [:183]. Being an ordinary upper-case letter one position from 'Y' in the alphabet, it also proves the arms match on EXACT CHARACTER EQUALITY rather than on a class of characters - a punctuation mark or a digit would leave open the reading that the switch rejects non-letters. A question mark was considered and DELIBERATELY REJECTED: common/FixedWidthRecord records that 0x3F is the US-ASCII replacement byte an encoder substitutes for an unmappable character, so a '?' sitting in a fixed-width parity image invites exactly the wrong reading. 'X' is representable under both code pages this corpus permits and cannot be mistaken for a substitution. IN SOURCE ORDER. :101-102 SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE and SET USR-MODIFIED-NO TO TRUE. :104-105 MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO, so the message field starts blank and the text below is the only thing that ever lands in it. :156 SET CONF-PAY-NO TO TRUE runs UNCONDITIONALLY at the top of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, before one byte of validation, so the confirmation flag is already 'N' when the rejection happens and not because of it. :158 EVALUATE TRUE; :159 WHEN ACTIDINI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES does NOT match, because eleven digits arrived; :165-166 WHEN OTHER / CONTINUE is taken and is a genuine no-op, so no error is raised by stage one. :169 IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON is therefore TRUE and stage two is entered. :170-171 ONE MOVE WITH TWO RECEIVERS moves ACTIDINI into ACCT-ID and XREF-ACCT-ID. :173 EVALUATE CONFIRMI OF COBIL0AI. :185 WHEN OTHER matches. :186 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG. :187-188 MOVE 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...' TO WS-MESSAGE. :189 MOVE -1 TO CONFIRML OF COBIL0AI. :190 PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN - EXACTLY ONE EMISSION, which is why sends carries one element and not two. :193-194 then run. :197-206 and :208-244 are both suppressed, because each opens with its OWN IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON and the flag is now on. Control falls to EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :146-149. THE ARM ORDER IS ITSELF THE EXPECTATION (gate G30). EVALUATE is ordered and first-match-wins, and WHEN OTHER is LAST. This arm is reachable ONLY because all six preceding clauses failed, so an implementation that folded 'Y' and 'y' into one case-insensitive test, or that hoisted WHEN OTHER above the SPACES clause, or that tested SPACES with a trim, would take a different arm for at least one input and this case would report a difference. The four WHEN bodies are also NOT interchangeable: 'Y'/'y' sets CONF-PAY-YES and reads the account, 'N'/'n' clears the screen and only THEN raises the flag, SPACES/LOW-VALUES reads the account WITHOUT setting CONF-PAY-YES, and WHEN OTHER neither reads nor clears. There is no fall-through between them. THE QUIRK THIS CASE EXISTS TO PIN: :193-194 ARE NOT INSIDE THE EVALUATE. END-EVALUATE is at :191 and END-IF for the :169 guard is at :195, so MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO WS-CURR-BAL [:193] and MOVE WS-CURR-BAL TO CURBALI OF COBIL0AI [:194] are the last two statements of the stage-two block and run on EVERY arm of the switch - including the two arms that have already raised the flag and, on this arm, already sent the screen. PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN is a paragraph call that RETURNS; it is not an exit. Reading the EVALUATE as though it returned is the single most likely way to get this case wrong. The two MOVEs are therefore preserved exactly where they are: not moved above the send, not wrapped in a guard, and not skipped because they look pointless. READ-ACCTDAT-FILE at :343-372 is reached only from :177 and :184, neither of which is on this arm, so the WORKING-STORAGE ACCOUNT-RECORD that COPY CVACT01Y brings in at :80 is NEVER POPULATED FROM A DATASET and :193 edits an area the program never filled. WHAT CURBALO THEREFORE CARRIES, AND WHY IT IS FOURTEEN SPACES RATHER THAN +0000000000.00. The parity fingerprint models PER-SEND SNAPSHOTS, not one end-of-invocation projection: each PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN appends the screen as it stood at that moment, which is what makes the send COUNT and the send ORDER assertable and is the only way the ordering defect above can be observed at all. The single send on this arm happens at :190, BEFORE :193-194, and CURBALI is written at exactly two sites in the whole program - :194, which has not run yet, and :564 inside INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS, which this arm never invokes - so the transmitted field still holds the fourteen spaces its working-storage item starts at. CURBALO is accordingly FOURTEEN SPACES, and those spaces are the positive evidence that the :193-194 edit was never transmitted. Do not read them as a cleared field or as a zero balance: they are an untouched field. For completeness, and because it is the value a reader will look for: the edit that :193-194 does perform yields '+0000000000.00' - fourteen characters, the sign position followed by ten integer digits, the decimal point and two fraction digits, which is WS-CURR-BAL PIC +9999999999.99 [:56] exactly - because the unfilled 300-byte area's ACCT-CURR-BAL reads 0.00. It lands in the field of a screen nobody will ever see with it, and it is NOT asserted here, because the fingerprint carries the transmitted snapshot and not the post-paragraph state. THE UNINITIALISED RECORD AREA IS A DOCUMENTED INTERPRETATION, NOT A CERTAINTY, and this is stated plainly rather than glossed. ACCOUNT-RECORD [app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy] carries no VALUE clause on any of its twelve items, and COBOL does not define the content of a WORKING-STORAGE item that has none, so the exact byte pattern the legacy program would have read at :193 IS NOT DETERMINABLE BY STATIC READING and no honest static derivation can name it. What is pinned instead is the Java translation's DETERMINISTIC counterpart: account/model/AccountRecord initialises its 300 bytes from its declared spans with category defaults, so every zoned numeric span is zero and ACCT-CURR-BAL reads 0.00 as a scale-2 BigDecimal, the same value on every machine and every run. That reading is an EXPLICITLY DOCUMENTED CHOICE about an inherently under-specified legacy construct, not an observed fact about the mainframe, and it is safe to pin here for one specific reason: the value is not transmitted on this path, so it is not observable on the screen and no expectation in this file depends on it. Nothing plausible has been invented in its place. THE MESSAGE, BYTE BY BYTE. The literal at :187 is 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...' - forty characters, with the full stop after 'value', the parenthesised '(Y/N)' and THREE trailing full stops, exactly as the source spells it. It is not re-punctuated, not shortened to a single ellipsis character and not trimmed. WS-MESSAGE is PIC X(80) [:39], so the MOVE left-justifies the forty characters and space-pads to eighty: the 80-byte working-storage image is the literal followed by forty spaces, and it is declared below as the single expectedMessages entry on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel. That entry is the WORKING-STORAGE field and is NOT a COBOL DISPLAY line - this path emits none, as set out under RETURN CODE AND EMITTED LINES below - and the channel exists precisely so the two cannot be confused. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN then does MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO at :293, and ERRMSGO is PIC X(78) [app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY], so an alphanumeric move TRUNCATES ON THE RIGHT and the two discarded bytes are both spaces. The 78-byte screen image asserted below as ERRMSGO is therefore the literal followed by thirty-eight spaces, counted rather than trimmed. The 80-byte and the 78-byte images are related but NOT equal, and both are stated on purpose: those two lost bytes are the whole reason the parity contract keeps the WS-MESSAGE and ERRMSG channels apart. THE ONE SEND, AND EXACTLY WHICH ITEMS IT CLAIMS. This case declares unitKind SERVICE, so the unit is billing.BillPaymentService.processEnterKey - the translation of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY from :154 onwards - and the send it records carries the FOUR items that paragraph and SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN write themselves: ACTIDINO at its declared eleven characters, CURBALO at fourteen, CONFIRMO at one and ERRMSGO at seventy-eight. Every width is taken mechanically from the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, whose xxxO items redefine the same spans under COBIL0AO REDEFINES COBIL0AI, and none is guessed. ACTIDINO goes back as the eleven characters that arrived, unchanged, and CONFIRMO goes back as the 'X' that arrived, unchanged: INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS at :560-566 is the only paragraph that blanks them and it is NOT invoked on this arm - it is reached from :137 and from :180, and this is neither. THE HEADER SIX ARE NOT CLAIMED HERE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE RATHER THAN AN OMISSION. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :291, and that paragraph at :319-338 moves WS-TRANID 'CB00' into TRNNAMEO [:38, :325], WS-PGMNAME 'COBIL00C' into PGMNAMEO [:37, :326], CCDA-TITLE01 '      AWS Mainframe Modernization       ' into TITLE01O [app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-19, :323], CCDA-TITLE02 '              CardDemo                  ' into TITLE02O [app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:20-22, :324], the eight-byte MM/DD/YY group WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY into CURDATEO [app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy:30-35, :332] and the eight-byte HH:MM:SS group WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS into CURTIMEO [app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy:36-41, :338]. In this translation that projection belongs to the controller and not to the service, so a SERVICE case that named those six fields would be asserting fields the unit under test cannot produce and the diff count could never reach zero. Their values are pinned by the CONTROLLER_POJO cases of this program. NO ATTRIBUTE IS ASSERTED, AND NONE MAY BE INVENTED. The attributes map is empty and must stay empty. COBIL00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - its COPY list at :63-85 is COCOM01Y, COBIL00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - and DFHRED appears nowhere in its 572 lines, so there is no red-and-asterisk highlight to expect and none is fabricated. app/bms/COBIL00.bms already declares ERRMSG as ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) COLOR=RED LENGTH=78 POS=(23,1), so the error line is red by mapset definition and needs no move. The only attribute byte this program ever writes is the DFHGREEN of :526, on the transaction-WRITE success arm this path never reaches. The only field-level emphasis the source performs here is the MOVE -1 at :189. CURSOR: CONFIRML, NOT ACTIDINL, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE DIAGNOSIS. Four of the five rejection paths in PROCESS-ENTER-KEY put the cursor on ACTIDINL - :163 for the empty identifier and :203 for nothing-to-pay - because the account field is what needs attention. This arm alone puts it on CONFIRML [:189], because it is the CONFIRMATION that is wrong. CONFIRML is an xxxL COMP PIC S9(4) length item, which is how CICS is told where to place the cursor, so it is declared as cursorField and is deliberately NOT smuggled into the payload as a field. app/bms/COBIL00.bms declares CONFIRM as ATTRB=(FSET,NORM,UNPROT) COLOR=GREEN HILIGHT=UNDERLINE LENGTH=1 POS=(15,60), an unprotected one-character field, which is what makes positioning the cursor there meaningful. NO NUMERIC VALIDATION IS PERFORMED ON ACTIDINI, AND THAT IS PRESERVED. :170-171 move ACTIDINI, PIC X(11), into ACCT-ID and XREF-ACCT-ID, both PIC 9(11), with no edit, no NUMVAL, no class test and no IF NUMERIC anywhere between :158 and :173. The only check the identifier receives in this whole paragraph is the SPACES-or-LOW-VALUES test at :159. The value used here is eleven digits, so the equal-width alphanumeric-to-numeric move is well defined and the absence of validation is not exercised destructively; the absence is nonetheless recorded, because adding a guard would be a new behaviour and a parity violation. NO ARITHMETIC IS PERFORMED ON THIS PATH, which is stated rather than left as a silent absence because a reader who sees CURBALO might reasonably expect a computation behind it. The program's only COMPUTE is at :234 and its only ADD is the identifier increment at :217, both inside the payment block at :210-242 that the error flag suppresses. Where a value does pass through a decimal representation - the 0.00 the record area reports and the edit at :193 - it is a BigDecimal at SCALE 2, the scale app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy fixes with ACCT-CURR-BAL PIC S9(10)V99, stored with RoundingMode.DOWN, which is the only faithful mode because the keyword ROUNDED appears ZERO times in all twenty-eight programs and COBOL therefore truncates excess fractional digits on store. Never double, never float, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN. WHY NOTHING IS SEEDED AND NO DATASET CHANNEL IS DECLARED. inputs, expectedWrites, expectedFinalState, expectedDatasets and normalisations are all empty BY DERIVATION AND NOT BY OMISSION. Every file operation this program owns is reached only from paragraphs this arm never enters: READ-ACCTDAT-FILE at :343-372 from :177 and :184; READ-CXACAIX-FILE at :408-436 from :211; STARTBR, READPREV, ENDBR and WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE at :441-547 from :213-233; and UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE at :377-403 from :235. So NO DATASET IS READ, NONE IS WRITTEN AND NONE IS EVEN OPENED. Seeding a row would assert a read the COBOL does not make and the case would stop being the zero-I/O case it exists to be. Gate G16 therefore has nothing to normalise, and G19, G21, G45 and G47 have no dataset to measure. STATELESSNESS. EIBCALEN is 218: the 160 bytes app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus the 58 bytes of the CDEMO-CB00-INFO group COBIL00C.cbl:64-72 appends in place. The one commarea item this path depends on is CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, which :112 tests through the CDEMO-PGM-REENTER condition name; it arrives 1 and LEAVES 1. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY neither reads another field of the area nor writes one; there is no XCTL on this path - the program's only transfer is EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) at :281-284 inside RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, reached only from MAIN-PARA at :109 and :135 - and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, the only thing that would move ZEROS into CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at :280, is not performed. The termination is accordingly RETURN_TRANSID and the pseudo-conversation continues carrying the area in the payload. nextProgram, nextMapset and nextMap are all absent: no transfer happened, and :296-297 names the mapset and the map on the SEND, which is the controller's projection rather than the service's. All conversation state - the area, the AID and the screen values - travels in the payload, so no server-side session state exists or is implied (gate G37, AAP rule R6). RETURN CODE AND EMITTED LINES. expectedReturnCode is 0. COBIL00C never assigns RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not appear in its 572 lines - and it contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD', so there is no abend and no non-zero exit to express; the failure is signalled entirely by WS-ERR-FLG holding 'Y' and by the screen message. Zero is stated rather than defaulted so the expectation says so. The only lines this program DISPLAYs are the DISPLAY 'RESP:' WS-RESP-CD 'REAS:' WS-REAS-CD statements on the WHEN OTHER arms at :366, :397, :430, :461, :490 and :541, every one of them inside a file-handling paragraph this path never enters - so no DISPLAY_LINE expectation is declared, and the one expectedMessages entry is the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE image described above and nothing else. PROVENANCE. Every value in this case is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:173-195, :289-301 and :319-338 and cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COBIL00.bms, the X(40) VALUE literals of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the eight-byte MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS groups of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, the twelve items of app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy and the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy - and it WAS NOT CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL EXECUTION, not one byte of it. Such a capture is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler as disabled, there are no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. AAP 0.7.6 documents eight independently verified blockers and 0.9.11 records the substitution as risk R-A, escalated for confirmation rather than absorbed. The uninitialised-ACCOUNT-RECORD reading described above is the one place in this case where static derivation reaches its limit, and it is flagged there as an explicitly documented interpretation rather than a certainty. DETERMINISM. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the instant every case in this directory pins and the very timestamp the CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 version footer at COBIL00C.cbl:571 carries, so a header rendered from it reads 07/19/22 and 23:12:32 rather than whatever the wall clock said. It is read through an injected Clock by way of common/DateHeader and never from a captured now. Two-digit month, day and hour, well clear of midnight and of any daylight-saving edge, so no rendering is ambiguous. No twenty-six-byte WS-TIMESTAMP is produced on this path: getCurrentTimestamp is reached only from the payment block the error flag suppresses. The pinned AccountRecord default is likewise a fixed value and not an environment-dependent one. The charset is named explicitly as US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default, which for a nine-fixture ASCII corpus and a twelve-dataset EBCDIC one is the difference between a comparison and a coincidence. UNIT KIND AND GATES. The service is constructed through its own constructor with stubbed collaborators and its method is called directly: no HTTP, no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no WebTestClient, no servlet container, no JobLauncher and no application context anywhere in the path, which is what gate G51 asks for. jobParameters is empty because a job parameter comes from a JCL PARM and this is an online invocation; COBIL00C has no JCL at all. The gates this case carries are G15, G18 with a diff count of zero, G23 for the scale-2 decimal even where the value is a default, G30 for the arm order of the EVALUATE CONFIRMI at :173-191 with WHEN OTHER last and reachable only after six preceding clauses fail, G37, G38 on its REENTER side and G51. G16, G19, G21, G24, G28, G32, G35, G39, G40, G45 and G47 do not apply, and their inapplicability is part of the case: no I/O, no reachable arithmetic, no GO TO, no abend, no pagination and no XCTL. THE EIGHTY-BYTE WS-MESSAGE IS NOT DECLARED AS AN EMITTED MESSAGE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: an online program emits nothing. app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:299 moves WS-MESSAGE into ERRMSGO and the value leaves through EXEC CICS SEND MAP, so the observable form is the send - pinned field for field in expectedResponse at the seventy-eight-byte width app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY declares, which is also the width at which the two-byte tail of an over-long message is lost. Declaring the working-storage value as well would assert a channel this program has none of and would duplicate an expectation the send already carries. BOTH DATASETS ARE DECLARED AT ZERO ROWS ON BOTH CHANNELS, which is this case's other assertion: app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD defines ACCTDAT and TRANSACT with STATUS(ENABLED) OPENTIME(FIRSTREF), so the files are available to transaction CB00 whether or not this arm reaches them, and pinning them at zero rows on the WRITES channel and at their seeded content on the FINAL_STATE channel is how 'this path touches no dataset whatsoever' becomes an assertion rather than a silence.
